launches.title: Memory Store - Your company's brain
launches.tagline: Shared memory for your company, people AND agents.
launches.body:
**tl;dr:** We collect insights from your team’s Slack, Gmail, and Granola, and turn them into a living memory accessible to every team member and agent. **Book a call [here](https://cal.com/team/memory).**\
\
**The Problem**

When AI makes your team 100x faster, it also creates 100x more things to keep track of. Decisions lost in Slack channels, insights buried in some Granola transcript, Claude chats, Codex sessions, and people's heads.

_Memory_ is the bottleneck now, because your teammates and agents both need the right context to move fast. This is why we built [Memory Store](https://memory.store/).\
\
<https://youtu.be/vncrqtgEPdY>

Book a call [here](https://cal.com/team/memory).

**How we solve it**

We collect insights from Slack, Gmail, Granola, and more; and synthesize them into a company brain and keep it up-to-date. Any agent that supports MCP can connect and access it (including ChatGPT Agents, Claude Cowork, Codex, OpenClaw, and [100s more](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/clients)) .\
\
We took this one step further with live “**Briefs**” — _living docs that update themselves_ whenever new memories are created! For example, we use them ourselves to track:

* Decision Logs
* Team Status Updates
* Customer Asks

Book a call [here](https://cal.com/team/memory).

**About us**

We’re [Diwank](https://x.com/diwanksingh) and [Ishita](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ishitajindal/). Diwank is a Thiel Fellow who's been building AI products since 2012 - his previous company powers phone ordering for Domino's, Wingstop, and Buffalo Wild Wings. Ishita ran products that served millions of users at Jar and Lenskart.

We have years of experience building agents for enterprises. We also built Julep, an open-source agent orchestrator with 7K+ GitHub stars, where we kept seeing the same bottleneck across every agent: memory. So we built Memory Store! 🙂
